summary:
I built the semantic layer in relay_dbt/models/semantic/. ./dbt parse and ./mf validate-configs both pass with no errors or warnings. Test queries return consistent numbers: for example, June 2025 opens with 1,220 paying customers, loses 34 and gains 26, ending at 1,212.

Rules I took from the data:
- Internal accounts excluded everywhere: the 60 Relay QA/Demo/Sandbox/Internal accounts (is_internal) are left out of every metric.
- Soft-deleted accounts are kept: 45 accounts are marked deleted, but 188 invoices were issued after the deletion date and most were paid, so their billing is real.
- A customer is the top-level parent account. Subsidiaries roll up into their parent and are counted once; customer segment and region come from the parent.
- Paying means the subscription status is active or past_due at month end. Trials and canceled subscriptions are excluded. Two subscriptions have overlapping versions that the existing mart counts twice; I keep only the latest version.
- MRR is seats x price x (1 - discount), with annual plans divided by 12, converted to USD at the month-end rate. JPY amounts are handled correctly because yen has no minor unit.
- Billings count open, paid and uncollectible invoices, net of discount and excluding tax. Draft and void invoices are left out.
- Recognized revenue uses the existing daily recognition logic but drops draft and void invoices, which the mart currently includes. It also includes future months of invoices already issued (for example, fiscal 2027 revenue from annual invoices).
- Cash collected counts only successful payments and includes tax.
- Refunds are credit notes: every credit note is against an invoice that was already paid, and the payments table has no refund entries.
- Billable usage counts only api_call events; health_check events are automated pings.
- Bookings are closed-won opportunities by close date. Win rate is won / (won + lost), counted by number of deals.

Metrics (29):
- Recurring revenue: mrr, arr, paid_seats, paying_subscriptions.
- Customers: paying_customers, arpa, new_customers, reactivated_customers (returning customers aren't counted as new), churned_customers, customers_at_period_start, logo_churn_rate, churned_mrr.
- Finance: billings, billed_tax, uncollectible_amount, recognized_revenue, cash_collected, failed_payments, refunds, refund_count, net_cash_collected.
- Usage and sales: billable_usage, bookings, new_bookings, expansion_bookings, won_deals, closed_deals, win_rate, open_pipeline.
MRR, seats and customer counts use the end-of-period value for quarters and years. Churn rate divides churned customers by the customers paying at the start of the period.

Semantic models (12): accounts, customers, plans, sales reps, monthly subscription and customer snapshots, invoices, revenue recognition, payments, refunds, daily usage and opportunities. You can slice by account or customer segment, region and country; currency; plan family and billing interval; sales rep and team; invoice type and status; payment method; refund reason; event type; and opportunity type and stage. Every model, dimension, measure and metric has a description of what it includes and excludes. Eleven small SQL helper models (sem_*.sql) do the cleanup and currency conversion.

Limitations:
- Fiscal year starts Feb 1. Fiscal year and quarter are regular dimensions on the event-based models (billings, revenue, cash, refunds, usage, bookings), not time grains on metric_time. Adding them as time grains needed a second daily time spine, which MetricFlow warns against. MRR and customer counts have no fiscal grouping, because grouping those by a regular dimension would give wrong end-of-period values.
- sem_fiscal_time_spine.sql has a misleading name: I couldn't delete files, so it became the fiscal calendar lookup. Renaming it would be tidier.
- Customer counts use month-end snapshots only, so a customer who starts and cancels within the same month never appears.
- Everyone paying in January 2023 counts as a new customer, because the data starts then.

Built the full MetricFlow semantic layer in relay_dbt/models/semantic/, all in that directory (only files kept):

Helper SQL models:
- int_subscription_month_snapshot.sql — deduplicated subscription x month-end snapshot (resolves a data-quality edge case where two version rows can claim the same month), joined to accounts/plans, with a monthly-equivalent USD mrr_usd computed (annual list prices divided by 12, not treated as 12x monthly). Bounded to 2025-06, the last month with real billing activity, so open-ended subscription versions don't extrapolate into future months. Excludes internal/test accounts.
- int_account_month_status.sql — account-grain monthly paying/not-paying status with first-paying-month and prior-month-drop flags, used for new-logo and churn detection at the account level (so a customer swapping subscriptions isn't miscounted as churn).

Dimension semantic models: sem_dim_accounts (segment, region, country, currency, internal/deleted flags), sem_dim_plans (plan family, billing interval), sem_dim_sales_reps (team, region).

Fact semantic models and metrics:
- sem_subscription_recurring_revenue: mrr, arr (derived), paying_customers, arpa (ratio) — filtered to active/past_due subscription-months.
- sem_account_month_status: new_customers, churned_logos, logo_churn_rate (derived with a 1-month offset).
- sem_invoices: billings (open/paid/uncollectible invoices, net of discount, excludes tax/draft/void).
- sem_revenue_recognition: recognized_revenue (ratable subscription recognition + point-in-time services recognition).
- sem_payments: cash_collected (succeeded payments only).
- sem_credit_notes: refunds (all reasons, sliceable by reason).
- sem_usage: billable_usage (api_call events only, excludes health_check heartbeats).
- sem_opportunities: bookings, new_bookings, win_rate (derived) from closed_won/closed_lost opportunities, joined to sales rep team/region.

Every metric excludes Relay's internal/test accounts and every model/dimension/measure/metric has a description stating exactly what's included/excluded. Verified via ./mf query that MRR/ARR/paying customers/ARPA trend sensibly, churn and new-customer counts behave correctly, and all requested dimensions (segment, region, currency, plan, sales team) work for slicing. `./dbt parse` and `./mf validate-configs` both pass with zero errors/warnings.

summary:
Built the Relay dbt semantic layer in relay_dbt/models/semantic/. Both ./dbt parse and ./mf validate-configs pass with zero errors and zero warnings, and every metric family was queried end to end with results matching independent SQL checks.

Defined:
- 9 helper models (sem_customers, sem_subscription_months, sem_customer_months, sem_invoices, sem_revenue_recognition, sem_payments, sem_credit_notes, sem_opportunities, sem_usage_daily) that exclude internal Relay demo/QA/sandbox accounts, roll child accounts up to a parent-level customer (logo), convert minor units to major units and USD at transaction-date FX, deduplicate overlapping subscription versions, and precompute status flags. Rebuild with ./dbt build --select path:models/semantic.
- 13 semantic models: accounts, customers, plans, sales_reps, fiscal_calendar (FY starts 1 Feb; every fact has a calendar_date entity for fiscal grouping), subscription_months, customer_months, invoices, revenue_recognition, payments, credit_notes, opportunities, usage_daily. All models, entities, dimensions and measures have include/exclude descriptions.
- 63 metrics: mrr, arr, mrr_local_currency, paying_customers (logo level), paying_accounts, paying_subscriptions, trialing_subscriptions, paying_seats, arpa, average_mrr_per_seat; new_customers, churned_customers, reactivated_customers, logo_churn_rate (1-month offset), new/expansion/contraction/churned/reactivation MRR, fx_impact_on_mrr, net_new_mrr, gross_mrr_churn_rate, net_mrr_retention_rate; billings (net of discount, pre-tax, open/paid/uncollectible only), billings_including_tax, invoiced_tax, invoice_discounts, uncollectible_billings, open_receivables, invoices_issued, recognized_revenue (draft/void excluded), cash_collected (succeeded payments), failed_payments, average_days_to_pay, refunds (all credit notes, all post-payment), net_cash_collected, refund_rate, local-currency variants; billable_usage (api_call on paying days, excludes health_check heartbeat and trial usage), api_calls, health_checks, accounts_with_billable_usage; bookings, new_bookings, expansion_bookings, won/lost/closed/open opportunities, win_rate, new_business_win_rate, expansion_win_rate, average_deal_size, open_pipeline, opportunities_created.

Key logic from the data: MRR = seats x price x (1-discount), annual /12, active+past_due only, non-additive over time; deleted accounts keep paying so deletion is not churn; canceled/trialing rows exist in the snapshot and carry zero MRR; revenue recognition mart included draft/void invoices which are now filtered; credit notes are cash refunds; health_check is a 288/day heartbeat.

Built Relay's dbt semantic layer in relay_dbt/models/semantic/ (3 files). subscription_mrr_monthly.sql helper table computes month-end MRR in USD (seats x price x (1-discount), annual/12, month-end FX) plus one-row-per-account flags for paying, first-ever-paid-month, churned (paid last month, not this month) and prior-month-paying. semantic_models.yml defines 10 semantic models (accounts, plans, sales_reps, subscriptions, invoices, revenue_recognition, payments, credit_notes, usage, opportunities) with join entities and slice dimensions (segment, region, country, currency, plan family/name/interval, sales team/region, invoice type/status, payment method/status, credit reason, opp type/stage). metrics.yml defines 20 metrics: mrr, arr (mrrx12), paying_customers, arpa, new_customers, logo_churn, logo_churn_rate, billings (pre-tax, paid/open/uncollectible), recognized_revenue, cash_collected (succeeded only, incl. tax), refunds (all credit notes), billable_usage (api_call only), bookings, new_bookings, expansion_bookings, opportunities_won/lost, closed_opportunities, win_rate. Every model, dimension, measure and metric has an includes/excludes description. Business logic from the data: active+past_due count as paying (trialing/canceled excluded); internal QA and soft-deleted accounts excluded everywhere (deleted accounts keep fake active rows; internal have 333 invoices); billings/revenue/bookings are pre-tax (opp amounts match subtotal-discount); health_check usage is constant monitoring noise (288/day) and excluded. ./dbt parse and ./mf validate-configs both pass with 0 errors, and all metric values were cross-checked against independent SQL.
